info.title: Identity & Workspace API
info.description: Implementation contract draft for team review. Work area: Identity & Workspace. See ../conventions.md, ../authentication.md, and ../workflows.md. All examples are synthetic.

servers.description: Local gateway; replace with HTTPS gateway in deployed environment.

post.description: Unauthenticated. Create a single-use random nonce valid for 5 minutes. Frontend passes nonce to Google Identity Services. Rate limit by client IP.

post.summary: Exchange verified Google credential for application session
post.description: Validate signature, issuer, configured audience, expiration, nonce and verified email; atomically consume challenge. Map identity using Google sub, never email alone. Session lasts 8 hours; no refresh token. Unknown/expired/consumed challenge: 401 AUTH_CHALLENGE_INVALID. See authentication.md.
Revokes only the presented session. 204 on first success; an already revoked credential returns 401. Frontend clears token in either case.

get.summary: Get current profile and owned workspace count

get.description: Only active memberships. Order created_at DESC, id DESC.

post.description: Creates owner membership atomically. Maximum 10 active owned workspaces; serialize quota check. 409 WORKSPACE_LIMIT_REACHED.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.
Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

patch.description: Owner only. Increment version on actual change.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

delete.description: Owner only. Atomically mark inaccessible, cancel pending invitations, revoke memberships, free ownership slot and outbox workspace.deleted.v1. Task cleanup is asynchronous. 204 means authoritative deletion committed.

get.description: Current member. Returns at most 20; order joined_at ASC, membership_id ASC. Optional q matches display name case-insensitively for mention picker; no email directory.

delete.description: Owner only; cannot remove owner (409 OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE). Removes current membership generation, clears access immediately, emits workspace.member_removed.v1. Already absent target while actor remains owner: 204.
Current non-owner leaves; emits workspace.member_removed.v1 with reason left. Work area: 409 OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE. Subsequent attempt after leaving: 404.

post.description: Owner only. Lookup and invite in one call; no separate public directory. Email is trimmed and compared case-insensitively; do not remove dots or plus aliases. Missing registered recipient: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; ambiguous email mapping: 409 EMAIL_AMBIGUOUS. Existing member or pending invite: 409. Pending invitations do not reserve member slots. Emits invitation.created.v1.

get.description: Owner only; newest first. Optional status filter.
Recipient only; newest first. Deleted workspace invitations are excluded. Optional status filter.
Recipient or current workspace owner only. Other actor/deleted workspace: 404.

post.description: Recipient only. Pending → accepted/declined atomically. Repeat same action on same terminal outcome returns 200 without new membership (including if user later left). Other terminal outcome: 409 INVITATION_NOT_PENDING. Accept at 20 members: 409 MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED; remains pending. New join creates a new membership_id.
Current owner only. Pending → cancelled; repeat cancelled returns same record. Accepted/declined: 409 INVITATION_NOT_PENDING. No request body.

get.description: Process responds; does not test dependencies.

get.description: Can serve required synchronous operations: database available; Task/Notification can reach Identity. Broker outage alone does not fail readiness if outbox can safely persist. 503 when unavailable.

servers.description: Private direct service probe; not exposed by public gateway.

sessionBearer.description: Opaque application session issued by Google exchange; NOT a Google ID token.

serviceKey.name: X-Service-Key
serviceKey.description: Per-caller secret. Task and Notification have distinct keys and endpoint allowlists.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional correlation UUID; gateway generates/replaces invalid values and echoes a UUID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID; retain the same value on retry. Scope and 24-hour retention: conventions.md.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong version ETag, e.g. "3". Required on resource PATCH/DELETE. Stale: 412; missing: 428.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same list, user, and filters. Invalid cursor: 400.

details.reason: Must be on or after start_date.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credentials.

404.description: Resource does not exist, is deleted, or is hidden from this actor.

409.description: Business conflict, capacity limit, terminal invitation, or idempotency key conflict.
